composition_strategy: Symmetrical balance with a central focus on layered architectural panels and subtle connected geometry, creating a sense of professional depth and modernity.
focal_strategy: A central point of focus with layered architectural panels and subtle geometric patterns that guide the eye towards the center, enhancing the sense of professionalism and modernism.
depth_strategy: Employing perspective techniques such as linear perspective and atmospheric perspective to create a sense of depth and three-dimensional space within the composition.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: A clean, symmetrical perimeter that frames the layered architectural panels and subtle connected geometry, providing a clear and professional boundary.
title_safe_region_strategy: A symmetrical, centrally placed title-safe region with ample space for the event title, ensuring it is prominent and easily readable.
programme_safe_region_strategy: A secondary, centrally aligned programme-safe region, ensuring that the layout is balanced and the programme information is easily accessible and readable.
role: Create a high-contrast, visually cohesive background that reflects the modern technology theme and provides a clean, professional setting for a corporate conference.
